description: Act on an uploaded evidence file (editor+): approve, reject or request revision; re-run validation; or soft-delete it (destructive). Pick with method.

evidence_id.description: Catalog evidence ID the file belongs to, e.g. E-IAM-01 [review, delete] | Evidence ID (e.g., 'ERL-IAM-001') — obtain from scf_list_evidence [revalidate]

file_id.description: Evidence file UUID — obtain from scf_list_evidence_files

method.description:
review: Approve, reject or request revision on one uploaded file (write — editor). Rejecting raises a deficiency on each in-scope control it supports. 410 where per-window review is on.
revalidate: Re-run the validation engine against an evidence file (write — editor+ role). Checks catalog existence, content type, field coverage, freshness, storage. Returns the updated result.
delete: Soft-delete an evidence file (destructive write — editor role). The record is marked deleted and drops out of listings; the stored object is retained for audit and retention.

name: scf_evidence_file_write
